title: Traffic stop — no helmet
officerCan: Stop the vehicle and point out that headgear was not worn.
Compound the offence if they are an officer notified for that purpose, at the prescribed amount.
officerCannot: Demand an amount other than the prescribed penalty.
Take cash without issuing a receipt or challan.
Take the vehicle keys as a way of forcing payment.

quotableLine.en: I will pay the correct penalty. Please issue the challan so I have a receipt.
quotableLine.hi: मैं सही जुर्माना भरने के लिए तैयार हूँ। कृपया चालान दे दीजिए ताकि मेरे पास रसीद रहे।
quotableLine.ta: சரியான அபராதத்தைச் செலுத்துகிறேன். ரசீது கிடைக்க சலான் வழங்குங்கள்.
quotableLine.te: సరైన జరిమానా చెల్లిస్తాను. రసీదు కోసం చలాన్ ఇవ్వండి.
quotableLine.bn: আমি সঠিক জরিমানা দেব। রসিদের জন্য চালান দিন।
quotableLine.mr: मी योग्य दंड भरतो. पावतीसाठी चलन द्या.
quotableLine.kn: ಸರಿಯಾದ ದಂಡ ಪಾವತಿಸುತ್ತೇನೆ. ರಸೀದಿಗಾಗಿ ಚಲನ್ ನೀಡಿ.

doNotSay: Do you know who I am?
Anything about who you know or who you will call.
documentNow: The officer's name and buckle number, and the amount being asked for.

options.label: Ask for a written challan instead of paying cash.
options.rationale: A challan creates a record; a cash payment with no receipt does not.
options.tradeoff: May take a few more minutes at the roadside.

options.label: Politely ask whether the officer is authorised to compound this offence.
options.rationale: Only notified officers may compound under s.200.
options.tradeoff: Ask once, calmly. Repeating it reads as a challenge.

options.label: Pay the amount asked and record everything for a later complaint.
options.rationale: Ends the encounter fastest and preserves your ability to complain afterwards.
options.tradeoff: You may pay more than the statutory amount.
